key_parts.question: According to Eurostat, what share of individuals in Germany used internet banking in the latest available year, and what was the value the year before?

answer.question: According to Eurostat, what share of individuals in Germany used internet banking in the latest available year, and what was the value the year before?
answer.answer: According to Eurostat, the share of individuals using internet banking in Germany in the latest available year (2025) was 70.71%, and in the year before (2024) it was 66.92% [eurostat_isoc_ci_ac_i_de].

chunks.text:
# Share of individuals using internet banking in Germany (Eurostat)

Source: Eurostat dataset isoc_ci_ac_i (Individuals - internet activities).

The latest available value of share of individuals using internet banking in Germany, for 2025, is 70.71%.

Recent observations:
- 2025: 70.71%
- 2024: 66.92%
- 2023: 57.22%
- 2022: 48.58%
